title: 教育部长辞职引爆抗议：莫迪遭遇罕见政治分水岭，青年不满远超考试泄题
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I just want to start with your view of what the implications are for Prime Minister Modi.
segments.zh: 首先想请您谈谈，这对莫迪总理意味着什么？

segments.en: This is a very rare setback for him. Yes, I think it's been really important and I would say a watershed moment over this last week.
segments.zh: 对他来说，这是非常罕见的挫折。是的，我认为过去一周确实是一个分水岭时刻。

segments.en: It has demonstrated both the extent of deep discontentment. The protest was triggered by
segments.zh: 这既显示了深层不满的程度，抗议的导火索是

segments.en: the examination paper leaks and the resignation of the education minister became the core
segments.zh: 考试试卷泄露和教育部长辞职成为核心动员议题，

segments.en: mobilizational issue but really the protest expanded much beyond that to express a discontentment with the nature of the in an economic growth story that has never actually structurally failed
segments.zh: 但抗议远不止于此，还表达了对经济增长故事的不满——这一增长从未在结构上为有抱负的年轻人创造足够就业。

segments.en: to create and generate jobs for the aspiring young. A failure of an education system that hasn't been invested in in a manner that makes the young,
segments.zh: 教育体系投入不足，未能让年轻人具备现代经济所需的能力，

segments.en: capacitated and capable in a modern economy but most importantly also a frustration with a government whose governance style has been broadly extremely authoritarian and not very sensitive
segments.zh: 但最重要的是，对政府治理风格的挫败感——其风格普遍极为威权，对民众诉求不敏感。

segments.en: to people's issues and it is that frustration that came out. The demand for the resignation of the minister was very much at the heart of a fundamental core truth about democracy that actors,
segments.zh: 这种挫败感爆发了。要求部长辞职的核心，是民主的一个基本真理：

segments.en: elected actors have to be responsive to and accountable to the citizenry and in shaping this
segments.zh: 民选官员必须对公民负责，并回应其诉求。
